name: 1inch
description: 1inch is a DEX aggregator that splits each swap across many liquidity sources to get a better price, with an intent-based Fusion mode in which resolvers fill orders without the user paying gas. It also offers limit orders, cross-chain swaps and its own wallet; 1INCH is the governance token.
description_zh: 1inch 是一个 DEX 聚合器，会把每笔兑换拆分到多个流动性来源以获得更好的价格，并提供基于意图的 Fusion 模式，由解析者（resolver）成交订单、用户无需支付 gas。它还提供限价单、跨链兑换和自有钱包；1INCH 是治理代币。

geo_site.method: 2022: US geo-block, since lifted (FAQ now says the US is available)

screening.provider: TRM Labs (help center); ToS also names BlockAid, Web3 Antivirus, MetaMask, Innerworks

notes: Closed. The 1inch API is public but needs a key; screening happens on 1inch's side. URL note: app.1inch.io -> 302.
